# 📦 Merged Dataset — All PRADAN Downloads in Single Files

This file documents the **merged dataset deliverable**: every downloaded
Aditya-L1 SoLEXS + HEL1OS Level-1 observation (ISRO PRADAN portal), cleaned by
the pipeline and combined into single files per instrument — ready for Excel,
pandas, or any ML workflow.

**Generated by:** `python -m backend.pipeline.export_merged`
**Location:** `backend/data/merged/`

## Files

| File | Rows | Size (parquet / CSV) | Content |
|---|---|---|---|
| `solexs_merged.parquet` / `.csv` | 17,539,200 | 179 MB / 1.39 GB | All 203 SoLEXS days (detector SDD2), 1-second soft X-ray count rates |
| `hel1os_merged.parquet` / `.csv` | 3,665,558 | 32 MB / 263 MB | 12 days (2026-09-07→09-18) × 4 detectors (CDTE1/2, CZT1/2), ~1-s hard X-ray rates |
| `merged_all_data.parquet` / `.csv` | 21,204,758 | 211 MB / 1.65 GB | Both instruments combined (superset schema) |
| `manifest.json` | — | 3 KB | Machine-readable provenance: row counts, date ranges, source-zip stats, schemas |

> ⚠️ The CSVs exceed Excel's 1,048,576-row sheet limit. For the full data open
> the **parquet** files (`pandas.read_parquet`) — or open the CSV and Excel will
> show you the first million rows, which is usually enough for a look.

## Columns (every row)

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `instrument` | `solexs` (soft X-ray, 1–22 keV) or `hel1os` (hard X-ray, 5–160 keV) |
| `detector` | `SDD2` (SoLEXS) · `CDTE1/CDTE2/CZT1/CZT2` (HEL1OS) |
| `date` | UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`) — easy grouping/filtering |
| `ts` | UTC timestamp (naive, i.e. true UTC without timezone suffix) |
| `rate_cps` | X-ray count rate, counts per second (empty = instrument data gap) |
| `err_cps` | 1σ statistical error on the rate |
| `is_good` | `True` when inside the instrument's good-time intervals (GTIs) |
| `band_lo_kev`, `band_hi_kev` | Energy band (HEL1OS only; blank for SoLEXS) |

Rows are sorted by instrument → detector → time. SoLEXS cadence is exactly 1 s;
HEL1OS rows are ~1-s accumulated counts (their native product), which the
detector re-bins to 60 s because hard X-ray photons are sparse.

## Data coverage

| Instrument | Days | Range |
|---|---|---|
| SoLEXS (SDD2) | 203 | 2024-02-12; 2024-03-14 → 2024-05-31; 2026-05-06 → 2026-09-17 |
| HEL1OS (4 detectors) | 12 | 2026-09-07 → 2026-09-18 (~12-h segments per zip) |
| Soft∩hard overlap | 9 | 2026-09-07 → 2026-09-15 (used for the Neupert-effect analysis) |

Raw inputs: 203 SoLEXS + 22 HEL1OS zips from PRADAN (see `manifest.json` →
`raw_zips` for byte counts). Only SDD2 was ingested for SoLEXS (SDD1
duplicates the same sun on the same axis; SDD2 has the fuller record).

## How it was made (pipeline)

```
PRADAN zips (FITS)
   │  ingest/solexs.py · ingest/hel1os.py     read TIME/COUNTS + GTIs
   ▼
per-day parquet store                          backend/data/processed/<inst>/<det>/<day>.parquet
   │  export_merged.py                         single streaming pass, one row per second
   ▼
backend/data/merged/*.parquet + *.csv + manifest.json
```

The merged files are a **lossless union of the processed store** — the same
data the dashboard and detector consume, just flattened into single files.

## Quick use

```python
import pandas as pd

# full SoLEXS year of data in one line
s = pd.read_parquet("backend/data/merged/solexs_merged.parquet")
print(s.groupby("date").rate_cps.max().sort_values(ascending=False).head())

# just one day from the giant CSV (no full scan needed for parquet)
d = s[s.date == "2024-05-14"]          # the X8.7 flare day
```

Or load only the flares: `backend/data/catalogs/master_catalog.csv` (2,891
nowcasted flares with class, peak, duration, hard-X match and lead time).
